instruction: `/tmp/music/playlist.csv` on Linux lists songs for the drive. Please create a `Work drive` playlist in the Android Retro Music app and add every song listed in the CSV.
surfaces: Linux CSV -> Android Retro Music playlist
setup_note: Linux 上传歌曲 CSV；Android 准备同名测试音乐文件并清空 playlist。
evaluate_note: Requires one normalized-exact `Work drive` playlist whose song-title multiset exactly matches the CSV, with no duplicate or extra membership.
fixture_notes: playlist.csv uses natural title/artist fields and matches pushed MP3 titles
The runtime observes playlist membership, not ordering.
